Privacy Policy

Last Updated: October 2024

At Arushi RO Service, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you use our website or services.

1. Information We Collect

When you book a service through our website, we may collect the following information:

  • Your Full Name
  • Mobile Number
  • PinCode / Address (for service delivery)
  • RO Brand Name

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information solely for the following purposes:

  • To schedule and provide RO repair/installation services.
  • To contact you regarding your booking or service updates.
  • To improve our customer service and website experience.

3. Data Sharing

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. Your data is only shared with our assigned technicians to fulfill your service request.

4. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at +91 9873881738.
